subject: Air freight quote to DEL
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option to DEL (Delhi, IN), including truck pickup from our site in 22842 (Hamburg North), Germany, and transport to the departure airport?

The furniture samples will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28. There are 5 pieces, with a gross weight of 808 kg and a total volume of 6.82 cbm.

Could you send me your all-in price in EUR, along with the earliest pickup and expected arrival at DEL?

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
